scope: Measured training-only counterfactual branches. Supervised choices are relabeled from these outcomes; they are not claims about learned-model performance.

objectives.tasks: Successful physical candidates only, lowest measured peak force, then duration.
objectives.recovery: Successful physical candidates only, least measured arm joint travel, then duration.
objectives.walking: Fixed reference follower; balance unique observed states across action classes.
objectives.provenance: Supervision is relabeled from actual identical-state counterfactual branches, not invented trajectories. Underlying source episodes used faster behavior to visit states. No held-out evidence informs labels.
